title: Weekday vs Weekend Drinking Split
dataSources: Alcohol drinks (`alcohol:drink`), vice logs (`vice:log`), hydration intake (`hydration:intake`), swear-jar entries (`swearjar:entry`).
app: Habit and sobriety trackers, alcohol-unit and hydration logs, vaping/smoking cessation apps, and a smart swear jar — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=alcohol:drink
| eval part=if(strftime(_time,"%w")>=1 AND strftime(_time,"%w")<=5,"weekday","weekend")
| stats sum(units) as units, dc(_time) as days by part
| eval per_day=round(units/days,2)
description: Compares your alcohol intake on weekdays versus weekends, showing whether a weekday habit has crept in.
value: Many assume they only drink at weekends; the split reveals whether that is actually true for you.
implementation: Ingest drinks into `index=personal`; compare units per day on weekdays versus weekends.
visualization: Bar chart of alcohol units per day, weekday versus weekend.
grandmaExplanation: It compares your drinking on weekdays versus weekends, revealing whether a midweek habit has slipped in.
